calibration.basis: Reassessed the same five anchors using coordinator knowledge of the game, prior calibration evidence, and the official description of deck placement, class choices, loot and camp gains. No new player horizon or new empirical result claimed.

calibration.limitations: Official description supports the feature relationships, not exact run durations, hidden combinations, late-game optimization or subjective feel. Those judgments use evaluator knowledge and the earlier calibration. This card never awards Riddle axes.
